'''Nuna Gumbo''' was a type of dish made with [[Nuna/Legends|Nuna]] meat. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Nuna Gumbo was served on [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora's]] [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], located on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].
